claims.text: The agent object requires schema, agent_id, display_name, workflow, language, allowed_seats, references, constitution_sha256, skills, memory_gen, brief_head_sha256, agent_version, generation, parents, born and status.
allowed_seats requires one to sixteen unique seat objects and references requires exactly gold_s1 and memory_v21 pins.
born.op is one of genesis, clone, distill, cross, mutate or specialize and conditions parents and generation via allOf branches.
rule_overrides is a bounded map of rule ids to add or remove and promoted_seat describes an absent-unless-shadow-or-promoted seat.

decision.rule: Change here when agent identity fields, seat bounds, reference pins, status values or born-conditioned rules need to change.
decision.failure: A genesis agent carries parents, a cross agent lacks two parents, or a single-parent operator gets the wrong parent count.

questions.q: Where is the agent record shape defined and which fields are required?
Where should I change allowed seats, references or born-conditioned parent rules?
Where can I debug a schema rejection for rule_overrides or promoted_seat?
